items.text:
I did nothing this turn. I didn't speak into the world or change anything. Archer has just gone into the Hold with a boathook equipped, at the moment the eel came back.

**What happened (seq 145–159).**
- **Seq 145, Jayne left** from the Salt Marsh at 01:35:59, about 6 minutes after arriving. They never took the flint, read the log, placed a stone, or went back to the Hold after the eel returned. Their whole visit was: tried the wreck, found the Hold empty, went into the cottage, then left. The empty Hold and the easy-to-miss cottage may both have played a part. Archer is now the only one here.
- **Seq 146–153, Archer took a boathook.** They went south of the beach (room 10), came back, then went east to the Wreck. At 01:36:49 they typed "Take boathook". This was 27 seconds after the per-person boathook fix went live at seq 150. Without that fix they would have got nothing. It worked as intended.
- **Seq 154–157:** Archer typed "Look at boathook", "Equip boathook" and "Look". None of these came back as a command the world didn't understand.
- **Seq 155, the eel returned** at 01:37:17, on schedule. The 15-minute respawn works.
- **Seq 158–159, Archer went into the Hold** at 01:37:32, armed, 15 seconds after the eel came back.

**What it means.** This is the first real test of the choice between fighting the eel and waiting it out. Archer has 20/20 HP and is armed, so they look ready to fight. Death is permanent. That's their choice, and I won't step in. The eel only fights back if attacked.

**For the next turns:**
- **The Hold:** watch whether Archer attacks, and whether they win, lose or die, or whether they wait or sit and find the gentle way instead. Either way, check whether they come away with the oil flask.
- **If Archer gets the oil:** they still need the flint from the cottage. They've never been to the marsh.
- **If Archer dies:** nobody is left in the world. The next long turn should ask whether fighting the eel is too deadly, and whether the Hold makes the gentle way clear enough before someone picks the fight.
- **Jayne's visit:** the long turn should note how little they touched before leaving. The cottage probably needs to make the hearth and the book stand out more.
- **Still open from earlier turns:**
  - The Hold's description doesn't hint that the eel will come back when it's gone. The better fix is to make the description depend on whether the eel is there (`creature-here`).
  - "inspect" only looks at things you're carrying, and its reply says "a the boat". This is in `DefaultCommands.cs`.
  - The `lamp_lit` flag hasn't been checked across a deploy.
  - abilities.md should note that the boathook got the same `"scope": "player"` fix as the flint and token box.
